paragraphs: Brooks Lee was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Sunday, batted 5th and started at 3B for Minnesota Twins against Milwaukee Brewers. Minnesota Twins fell to Milwaukee Brewers, 3-4.
Brooks Lee tied the game in the fifth with a home run.
Brooks Lee went 2-for-5, 1 home run, 1 RBI, 1 run scored.

title: Brooks Lee delivers in a key spot
